en_us: It would seem this world holds more than meets the eye. There are things I will conclude in this book, my writings of acquired knowledge of the obscurity that resides here. I have discovered a dark way of living with the creatures of this world. “&oWhat evil will come of this&r”, I ask myself? “&oEvil lurks in every corner&r”, I hear a dark voice within me reply. I have discovered a few secrets within this vast world of silly villagers and zombies, something their puny minds will never comprehend.
zh_cn-old: 这个世界远不止我看到的那样，这就是我要在这本写着我浅显知识的书里说的。我发现了一种黑暗的方式和这个世界的生物一起生活。 “&o这会造成什么邪恶&r”，我问自己。 “&o反正邪恶潜伏在各个角落&r”，黑暗的角落传来心声。我发现了这广阔世界的一些秘密，一些愚蠢的村民和僵尸永远不可能理解的秘密。
zh_cn: 这个世界远比表面所见更为深邃。我将在此书中总结关于这些潜藏于世间的晦暗存在的知识。我发现了一种与世间生命相处的独特方式，一条偏离正道的黑暗之路。“&o这将招致何等邪恶&r”，我扪心自问。“&o邪恶蛰伏于每个角落&r”，我心底的黑暗之声回应道。在这个充斥着愚昧村民与僵尸的广袤世界里，我窥见了某些他们渺小心智永远无法理解的奥秘。

en_us: Many kinds of magic exist in this world, but the kind you can achieve with &4Blood&0 seems different. I've noticed people cutting themselves for obtaining &4Blood&0, I prefer to spare my strength for some other things...
zh_cn-old: 这个世界已经存在着很多种魔法，但与这种使用 &4血液&0 来实现的魔法似乎有所不同。我注意到有人为了得到&4血液&0而割伤自己，但我更想把精力放到别的方面。
zh_cn: 这个世界早已存在着多种魔法，但这种使用&4血液&0达成的魔法似乎有所不同。我注意到有人为了&4血液&0选择割伤自己，但我更想把精力放到别的方面。

en_us: Introduction

en_us: I have discovered several strange new things lately. They all give off some eerie vibe, the longer I am around those things, the more I feel accustomed to it... Not all of these things might be very useful right away, but I might have some ideas to use them for something else.
zh_cn-old: 最近我发现了一些奇怪的新东西。它们都发出一些阴森恐怖的氛围，我在这些东西旁边呆的时间越长，我就越习惯于这些……虽然现在这些东西不是所有的都非常有用，但是我有一些利用它们的想法。
zh_cn: 近来，我发现了一些奇异的新事物。它们都散发着某种诡谲的气息，越是接触这些存在，我竟越发习以为常……尽管这些发现未必能即刻派上用场，但我已萌生出将其另作他用的构想。

en_us: As you are reading this book, you might have already come across this item. Combining an &1Apple&0 and a &1Dark Gem&0 results in a special &1Apple&0 that when eaten inflicts large amounts of damage for a certain time. If the entity dies because of this effect, it will leave behind some kind of anomaly. I have yet to discover any uses for this phenomenon...
zh_cn-old: 当你读这本书的时候你可能已经发现了这个东西。将一个&1苹果&0和一个&1暗黑宝石&0结合得到一个特殊的&1苹果&0，吃掉它就会在一段时间内造成大量伤害。 如果生物因为这种效果死亡，还会在死亡点留下某种异常。我到现在还没有发现这种现象的用处……
zh_cn: 在阅读本书时，你可能早已发现了这个物品。将一个&1苹果&0与一颗&1暗黑宝石&0结合，得到一个特殊的&1苹果&0，食用后，会在一定时间内受到大量伤害。若实体因该效果死亡，会在原地留下某种异常。我还未能发现这种现象的用处……

en_us: While caving, I occasionally encounter these grim rooms with &4Blood&0 spread all over the floor. These &4Blood&0 traces are probably caused by the battles of previous explorers with the countless mobs inhabiting these dungeons.
zh_cn-old: 在探测洞穴的时候，我偶尔会遇到一些&4血液&0洒满地板的狰狞的房间。这些&4血液&0的痕迹可能是以前的探险家与无数的怪物在这作战时留下的。
zh_cn: 在探索洞穴时，我偶尔会遇到一些地板上满是&4血液&0的狰狞房间。这些&4血液&0痕迹可能是以前的探险家与地牢中无穷无尽的怪物战斗时留下的。

en_us: Dark Temple
zh_cn-old: 黑暗神庙
zh_cn: 暗黑神庙

en_us: There seem to be certain structures in this world that were built by some kind of ancient civilization that was able to infuse certain environmental powers into items. These processes however seem to degrade the natural balance of the environment the more this process is used. This is possibly the main reason why that civilization isn’t around anymore today...
zh_cn-old: 这些有着一定结构的建筑似乎是由某种古老的文明建造，通过它可以向物品中注入特定的环境能量。看起来这个方法会随着使用破坏环境的平衡。这可能也是现在这个古老文明不再存在的原因……
zh_cn: 世界上存在着一些似乎是由某种古老的文明建造的建筑，通过它可以向物品注入特定的环境能量。然而随着进行次数的增加，环境的自然平衡似乎也在逐渐退化。这很可能正是该文明最终消亡的原因……

en_us: Using &1Dark Gems&0 I was able to enhance existing &1Glass Bottles&0 to be able to contain environmental weather. Throwing such a &1Weather Container&0 inside the core of such a temple will absorb the current weather into the bottle.
zh_cn-old: 使用&1暗黑宝石&0就能强化&1玻璃瓶&0使它能够容纳天气。向神庙的核心扔这些天气容器，就能吸收当前的天气，装入瓶内。
zh_cn: 利用&1暗黑宝石&0，我得以强化&1玻璃瓶&0，使它能够容纳环境天气。将这种&1天气容器&0投掷到神庙核心处，就能将当前的天气吸收入瓶内。

en_us: I also discovered that certain items can be empowered using the special properties of thunderstorms. These items can also be empowered when they are directly struck by lightning, but it seems very unlikely to predict where lightning is going to strike, or is it...?
zh_cn-old: 我发现某些物品可以通过雷暴天气的特殊性能充能。这些物品可以通过被直接雷击充能，但是被闪电直接命中似乎不太可能，还是说……？
zh_cn: 我还发现某些物品可利用雷暴天气的特殊性质进行充能。而当这些物品被闪电直接击中时也能获得充能，但预测闪电会劈中哪里似乎不太可能……真的是这样吗？

en_us: These temples seem emit some kind of energy, maybe I can find some way to detect this and discover new temples in the world?
zh_cn-old: 这些神庙似乎都发散出某种能量，也许我可以找到一种方法检测它并用于发现新的神庙？
zh_cn: 这些神庙似乎能散发出某种能量，也许我可以想办法检测这种能量，并以此来寻找新的神庙？

en_us: Our world is made up of &1Biomes&0, many different variantions exist. Unfortunately, we can not choose the location of these &1Biomes&0, or at least not always.

zh_cn: 我们的世界由许多不同的&1生物群系&0组成。不幸的是，我们不能选择&1群系&0所在的位置，至少以前不能。

en_us: One of the abilities of the &1Environmental Accumulator&0 is that it can accept special &1Biome Extract Bottles&0 which it can fill with the &1Biome&0 the machine is currently placed in. These bottles can be thrown anywhere on the ground to transform that area to the given biome.
zh_cn-old: &1环境存储器&0的其中一个能力就是将它所在的&1生物群系&0装入特殊的&1群系要素空瓶&0中，这些&1群系要素瓶&0会将目标区域转换为所含的&1生物群系&0。

zh_cn: &1环境蓄积器&0的最大缺点就是会随时间推移“退化”周围的生物群系，这之后产生的群系要素瓶就没有作用了。要是有另一种没有不良效果的&1群系要素瓶&0制作方法就好了……

en_us: It seems that there are some new creatures in this world. This creature appears to be a pretty large type of dragonfly. During the day time it is a rather peaceful creature, but do not be fooled, for if you would venture too close in proximity of this insect, it will try to poison you as though it being some kind of self defense. At night however, this beasty becomes subdued by an ancient evil and kills everything in its path. I deem myself lucky they have no other weapons besides actively looking me up at night to come and poison me. I managed to kill quite a few of these annoying things and carved some interesting poison sacs from their bodies. I have thrown them in a &1Bucket of Water&0 and the water really absorbs the poison well when I throw in four of these. I have long done the same with &lPoisonous Potato’s&r as well. It can be useful in a pinch for defending my evil lair... Ehm, I mean house... I named this creature after the dutch word for it’s kind, because I did not want to let it be confused with ordinary dragon flies, for obvious reasons...
zh_cn-old: 似乎这个世界还有一些新生物。这种生物好像是大号的蜻蜓。在白天的时候是一种相当和平的生物，但是不要被它的表象欺骗，如果你靠得太近，它就会叮咬你，这似乎是它们的一种自卫方式。而在晚上，这种野兽就会因其骨子里的邪恶而变的狂暴，杀掉它经过的一切生物。我认为至少我是幸运的，它们除了晚上主动来叮咬我再没有其他办法了。我设法杀死了一些这种烦人的生物，从他们的尸体上得到了一些有趣的毒囊。我把它们扔进&1一桶水&0，很快溶解了4份毒囊。我也可以用&l毒马铃薯&r来配制。 他们在关键时候可以保护我的邪恶老巢……呃，我的意思是家……
zh_cn: 看来这世界上又出现了一些新生物。这种生物似乎是一种体型相当巨大的蜻蜓。在白天，它是一种相当温和的生物，但别被表象骗了，如果靠得太近，它会试图用毒素攻击你，这似乎是某种自卫方式。然而到了晚上，这种怪物会被某种古老的邪恶力量支配，屠戮沿途所有生命。我觉得自己还算幸运，毕竟它们除了在夜间主动搜寻并用毒液攻击我之外，并无其他武器。我成功杀死了一些这种恼人的生物，并从其体内剖出了一些有趣的毒囊。当把四个毒囊投入&1水桶&0中时，我发现水能有效吸收毒素。之前处理&l毒马铃薯&r时也采用过类似方法。这或许能在关键时刻用来守卫我的邪恶老巢……呃，我是说房子……我特意用荷兰语中对应物种的词汇为其命名（Libelle），毕竟不能让它和普通蜻蜓产生混淆……

en_us: Whilest I was exploring this world, I have taken rest in many villages. One of the towns I rested in had a strange looking fellow in it. I started talking to him and it soon struck me he was not as interested in emeralds as the other people in his town. In fact he started asking more and more questions about the dark ore I had discovered, we talked away hours and hours. He was so keen about getting his hands on them and other objects I have discovered that we ended up trading things for most of the rest of the day. When night had fallen, he took me to his house in the village and he said I was most welcome to spend the night in his spare bedroom. I said I already rented a room at the local inn but thanked him for his kindness anyway. As I crawled into bed in the inn, I took a last glance at the moon, as I usually do before going to sleep and I saw it was a nice full moon. As I closed my eyes, all of a sudden, I heard a loud distressed shout and after that a wolf-like growl. The whole village was looking through their windows and we saw a tall wolf, walking on its hindlegs. Everyone cowered in fear, but I, without fear nor doubt, took up my trusty dagger and gave it a pretty good beating. It was a very strong creature, his fur will make a nice memento to his great fight...When I woke up the next morning to conclude my trading session of the day before, my strange trading friend had taken a leave. There where claw marks all over his house and there was &4Blood&0 on the floor, I still wonder if the strange wolve ate him... Or if perhaps he was a werewolf, as the villagers gossip on... It looks like I can convert his drops to regular items when just placing them inside a &1Crafting Table&0.
zh_cn-old: 当我在探索这个世界时，我在许多村庄休息过，有个村庄里有个古怪的家伙。我开始和他交谈，他让我很震惊，他不像村庄里的其他人，他对绿宝石并没有兴趣。然而，他却向我追问许多关于我发现的黑色宝石的问题，我们详谈甚欢以至于忘记了时间。他非常渴望马上入手那些我发现的宝石，整个下午都在和我交易。夜幕降临后，他把我带到他家，说非常乐意给我借宿一宿。我说我已经在当地的旅馆租了一间房，并感谢他的好意。当我爬到旅馆的床上时，我最后看了一眼月亮，因为我经常在睡觉前这么做，这是一个美好的满月。当我要闭眼时，突然我听到一声痛苦的喊声，像狼的咆哮。整个村庄的村民都向窗外看去，我们看到的是一个巨大的狼，后腿直立。每个人都在恐惧中颤抖，除了我，没有任何恐惧和犹豫，拿起我的匕首，给了它漂亮的一击。它一个非常强大的生物，它的皮毛将是纪念我伟大战力的很好的纪念品……当我第二天醒来去结算前一天的交易，那个古怪的家伙已经离开了。在他家有爪的抓痕，地板上有&4血迹&0，我在想是不是那个奇怪的狼人生物吃了它……或者也许他就是一个狼人，就像村民们八卦的那样……似乎我可以通过&1工作台&0将狼人骨头转化为骨粉。
zh_cn: 在探索世界的过程中，我曾在不少村庄落脚休息。其中某个村庄里，有个形貌古怪的家伙。我与他攀谈，很快发觉他对绿宝石的兴趣远不如镇上其他人。事实上，他开始对我之前发现的那种黑色宝石刨根问底，我们畅谈了数小时之久。他对入手这些宝石以及我发现的其他一些东西如此热切，以至于我们在那天的剩余时间里几乎一直在交易。夜幕降临后，他邀我去他家里下榻。我说我已经在旅馆订过房间里，只能谢过他的好意。爬上旅馆的床，准备入睡前，我像往常一样望了望月亮，发现是一轮皎洁的满月。正当我闭眼之际，突然间，一声凄厉的嚎叫传来，继而是狼一般的低吼。全村人都扒着窗户窥探，映入眼帘的赫然是一匹人立而起的巨狼。众人瑟缩惊惧，只有我毫不迟疑地拿起随身匕首狠狠揍了它一顿。这凶兽着实凶猛，其皮毛权当是这场恶战的纪念……次日清晨，我本想继续昨日的交易，才惊觉那个古怪的贸易伙伴已经离开了。他的房子里遍布着爪痕，地板上还残留着&4血液&0。我至今仍然困惑，到底是那怪狼吞了他……还是像那些村民八卦的那样，他本来就是个狼人……看来只需将这些掉落物放入&1工作台&0，便可将其转化为寻常物品。

en_us: Once upon a time while I was visiting hell, I discovered a block of &1Netherrack&0 that was a bit harder to break than normally. But after breaking the block, I noticed a little creature popping out and it started to attack me. It lit me on fire and I took some mild damage, luckily I was able to kill it without much trouble.
zh_cn-old: 有一次，在我参观下界时，我发现一块&1下界岩&0比正常的有点难以敲碎。但是当我打破石头时，我发现一个小生物突然出现并开始攻击我。它使我着火，并对我造成了一些伤害，幸运的是我很容易就杀死了它。
zh_cn: 曾经有一次在地狱探险时，我发现了一块&1下界岩&0，它比正常的要难破坏一些。但当我破坏这个方块后，有个小生物跳了出来并开始攻击我。它把我点燃了，让我受了些轻伤，不过幸好，我没费多大力气就解决了它。

en_us: Relics
zh_cn-old: 杂项
zh_cn: 遗物

en_us: You might never have noticed before, but when players die they seem to drop a part of their flesh. Eating it seems to be dangerous, maybe eating it at night-time might be more safe. I wouldn’t recommend eating your own flesh though, that’s just nasty, try eating one of your friends instead!
zh_cn-old: 你可能之前都没有注意到，在玩家死后会掉落一些他们的肉。吃人肉似乎很危险，在晚上吃可能更安全。不过我不建议吃你自己的肉，那太恶心了，试试你朋友的吧！
zh_cn: 你之前可能都没注意到过，但玩家死后会掉落一块他们的肉。吃起来似乎有点危险，可能在晚上吃会更安全些。不建议吃自己的肉，这也太恶心了，还是尝尝朋友的吧！

en_us: Enchantments
zh_cn-old: 附魔
zh_cn: 魔咒

en_us: &l&nCurse of Breaking&r&NThis enchantment exists in three stages, it looks like it does exactly the opposite of the Unbreaking enchant. This doesn’t seem very useful, does it? Maybe I should find a way to get rid of this.
zh_cn-old: &l&n破碎诅咒&r&N这个附魔有三个等级，它的作用和&1耐久&0完全相反。这看起来很没用，不是吗？或许我需要一种摆脱它的方法。
zh_cn: &l&n破碎诅咒&r&N该魔咒有三个等级，它的作用似乎与&1耐久&0魔咒完全相反。看起来没什么用，不是吗？也许我该找个法子摆脱它。

en_us: &l&nLife Stealing&r&NThe three stages of this enchant on offensive weapons allows you to steal parts of the life you take from others.
zh_cn-old: &l&n吸血&r&N这三个等级的附魔能让你在攻击时偷取生命。
zh_cn: &l&n吸血&r&N该魔咒有三个等级，拥有该魔咒的武器在攻击时，能偷取部分造成的伤害转化为生命值。

en_us: &l&nPoison Tip&r&NWhen applying some poison to your weapons, you have a chance of poisoning your victims.This enchantment exists in three stages. It looks like you can make a basic version of this enchantment by adding a poisonous material to a regular book.
zh_cn-old: &l&n淬毒&r&N当你把都涂在你的武器上时，你有机会使被攻击的生物中毒。这个附魔有三个等级。你可以&1毒液桶&0和正常的&1书&0结合制造基础的淬毒附魔书。
zh_cn: &l&n淬毒&r&N通过在武器上涂毒，你有概率使被攻击的生物中毒。该魔咒有三个等级。似乎可以通过将一本普通的书与某种毒性材料合成，来获得基础的淬毒附魔书。

en_us: &l&nUnusing&r&NI was getting tired of my favorite tools breaking everytime I wasn’t paying attention to them. This I why I devised a new enchantment that makes tools unusable when they are about to break, giving myself enough time to repair it to its former glory.
zh_cn-old: &l&n保险&r&N我讨厌一不小心就用坏了我心爱的工具。因此我设计了一个新的附魔，在工具快坏掉时使它们无法被使用，这样就使我有机会修复它，恢复它昔日的辉煌。
zh_cn: &l&n保险&r&N我受够了心爱的工具总在疏忽间彻底损毁。因此我设计出了一种新魔咒，它能使工具在濒临损坏时变得无法使用，从而给我足够的时间将其修复如初。

en_us: &l&nCurse of Vengeance&r&NTools with this enchanment will spawn Vengeance Spirits when used.
zh_cn-old: &l&n复仇诅咒&r&N当有这个附魔的工具在使用时会召唤复仇之魂。
zh_cn: &l&n复仇诅咒&r&N使用拥有该魔咒的工具时，会生成复仇之魂。

en_us: Dark Tank
zh_cn-old: 暗黑液体罐
zh_cn: 暗黑流体罐

en_us: Using some &1Iron&0, &1Dark Gems&0 and a piece of &1Glass&0, it is possible to construct a strong container that is able to hold fluids. It is possible to place these tanks somewhere, or hold them in your inventory.
zh_cn-old: 使用一些&1铁&0，&1暗黑宝石&0和一块&1玻璃&0，就能制造一个容纳液体的强大容器，可以放置或者放在背包里。
zh_cn: 用一些&1铁&0、&1暗黑宝石&0以及一块&1玻璃&0，就能制造出一个能够容纳流体的坚固容器。其可以放置在世界中，也可以在物品栏里随身携带。

en_us: When it is placed somewhere, you can right-click which gives it a purple-ish glow, and it seems to open up a hole at the bottom of the tank which is able to automatically fill tanks, item containers and players carrying containers underneath it.
zh_cn-old: 当放置后，可以右击使它散发紫色的光辉，似乎在容器底部产生了一个洞，这使它可以自动填充在它下面的容器，物品，或者附近玩家携带的容器。
zh_cn: 放置后，可以右击使它散发紫色的光辉，这似乎在其底部打开了一个洞，使它可以自动填充其下方的流体容器，物品形式的流体容器，或者玩家携带的流体容器。

en_us: Shift + right-clicking with the tank in your hand and not aiming at a block (because you know you will just place the tank down if you would do so) will enable a special mode to make it automatically try to fill any container you are currently holding if it can accept that fluid.
zh_cn-old: 对着空气Shift + 右击手中的储罐，它就会开启自动补给模式，自动补满当前持有的容器。
zh_cn: 使用流体罐对着空气Shift右击（毕竟如果对着方块就会直接放置下来），将激活自动补给模式，自动填充当前持有的流体容器。

en_us: It looks like it can hold about sixteen buckets. If that is too limiting for you, these tanks seem to be expandable by placing multiple ones inside a crafting table, no fluids seem to go lost in this process.
zh_cn-old: 它似乎可以容纳16桶液体。如果这对你来说还是太少，它们似乎可以通过工作台叠加合成增加容量，并且在这个过程中液体不会丢失。
zh_cn: 它似乎可以容纳16桶流体。如果这对你来说还是太少，它们似乎可以通过工作台叠加合成增加容量，并且流体在这个过程中不会丢失。

en_us: Spikes
zh_cn-old: 针管
zh_cn: 尖刺

en_us: Using a &1Dark Gem&0 and a piece of &1Iron&0, I was able to create very sharp and durable &1Spikes&0. Mobs don't seem to like them very much...
zh_cn-old: 使用一个&1暗黑宝石&0和一块&1铁&0，我制造了非常锋利的&1针管&0。小怪物们似乎并不喜欢这个东西……
zh_cn: 使用一个&1暗黑宝石&0和一块&1铁&0，我可以做出非常锋利且耐用的&1尖刺&0。怪物们似乎并不喜欢这个东西……

en_us: Some &1Spikes&0 and a &1Plate&0 will result in a plate which will damage any mob walking over it, me and my peers don’t seem to take any damage though. The powers of the &1Dark Gem&0 seems to ensure killing mobs in this process to drop the same things when killed by any player.
zh_cn-old: 用一些&1针管&0和一个&1测压板&0就能制造钉刺板，它会对走过的任何生物造成伤害，除了玩家。&1暗黑宝石&0的能量使得钉刺板杀死生物也会像玩家杀死生物一样，掉落同样的东西。
zh_cn: 用一些&1尖刺&0和一个&1压力板&0就能制造钉刺板，它会对走过的任何生物造成伤害，我和我的同类似乎不会受到伤害。&1暗黑宝石&0的力量使得以此法杀死的生物，会掉落与玩家击杀时相同的掉落物。

en_us: For your convenience, they also give off a redstone signal when a mob is taking damage.
zh_cn-old: 为了使用方便，在对生物造成伤害的时候它会产生红石信号。
zh_cn: 为了使用方便，钉刺板对生物造成伤害时会发出红石信号。

en_us: Nothing is more annoying than swapping tools around when trying to break blocks, and the suddenly having to fight incoming mobs.
zh_cn-old: 没什么比挖掘时切换工具和怪物战斗更烦人了。
zh_cn: 最烦的莫过于来回切换用于挖掘方块和抵御来袭怪物的工具了。

en_us: Combining some &1Spikes&0 allows you to break almost all soft materials very quickly. At the same time, any mobs that come creeping by can also be attacked with sufficient power.
zh_cn-old: 将一些&1针管&0 组合成工具可以让你快速破坏几乎所有的柔软方块。同时，任何想要偷袭的怪物都会受到足够的伤害。
zh_cn: 将一些&1尖刺&0组合成工具可以让你快速破坏几乎所有的柔软方块。同时，也可对任何想要偷袭的怪物造成可观的伤害。

en_us: Potentia Sphere
zh_cn-old: 神秘球
zh_cn: 潜能球

en_us: Combining several shiny mundane items will result in a sphere that seems to possess some awesome powers, I might discover a way to harness these powers in the near future. It looks like the power can be inverted by using some &1Dark Gems&0.
zh_cn-old: 和几个普通物品结合就会诞生一个拥有神奇能量的球，我以后应该能发现使用这种能量的方法。这种能量好像可以用一些&1暗黑宝石&0来转化。
zh_cn: 将一些闪闪发光的寻常物品结合，就会诞生一个拥有神奇能量的球，也许不久之后，我就能找到使用这种能量的方法。似乎可以用一些&1暗黑宝石&0来反转这种能量。

en_us: Combining some &1Sugar&0 and &1Gunpowder&0 will result in a weird dust that doesn’t seem to be very useful at the moment, hence the name. Although this might change one day.
zh_cn-old: 用一些&1糖&0和&1火药&0结合，就能制作一些奇怪的粉末，目前看起来毫无用处，所以命名为暗尘。可能以后会有所改变。
zh_cn: 将一些&1糖&0和&1火药&0结合，就能制作出一种古怪的粉末，目前看起来毫无用处，所以命名为暗尘。可能以后会有所改变。

en_us: Obscured Glass
zh_cn-old: 毛玻璃
zh_cn: 阻光玻璃

en_us: Some people might find regular &1Glass&0 too bright. Combining some glass with a &1Dark Gem&0 seems to make a special type of glass that almost completely reduces the amount of light that gets through. I am still able to look through the glass though, very strange...
zh_cn-old: 有人觉得普通&1玻璃&0太亮了。结合一个&1暗黑宝石&0就会形成一种几乎完全减少光线通过的毛玻璃。但是我还是能通过玻璃看东西，好奇怪……
zh_cn: 有人可能觉得普通的&1玻璃&0太亮了。将一些玻璃与一个&1暗黑宝石&0结合，就能制作出一种几乎能完全阻挡光线通过的特殊玻璃。但是我还是能通过玻璃看到东西，真是奇怪……

en_us: Exalted Crafter
zh_cn-old: 合成包
zh_cn: 崇高合成包

en_us: Crafting tables can be inconvenient sometimes when at remote locations. It looks like the &1Crushed Dark Gems&0 give the power to craft things from within your inventory! Attaching some kind of chest to it gives an easy internal inventory, even your &1Ender Chest&0 seems to work. Power users might be happy with this item, since it can be bound to a hotkey. Using that same hotkey when the gui is open will clear your inventory, and using the hotkey with shift will balance all the items currently inside the grid. There is a toggle button available that allows you to switch between the return targets when shift-removing items from the crafting grid, you can choose between either the inner item inventory or your player inventory.
zh_cn-old: 有时在遥远的地方，合成台并不在身边。 而&1暗黑宝石粉&0可以赋予你在物品栏合成的方法！和箱子合成来获得一些简单的内部空间，甚至是&1末影箱&0 看起来也可以工作。可以绑定热键。在合成包的界面，使用相同的热键就可以把正在合成的物品拿到玩家背包，按住Shift在使用热键就能把合成栏的物品平均起来。合成包界面有一个切换按钮可以切换返还物品的模式，你可以在内置储存和玩家背包之间切换。
zh_cn: 身处偏远之地时，传统工作台就不怎么方便了。但&1暗黑宝石粉&0似乎能赋予直接在物品栏中合成的能力！将其与箱子合成，便可获得便捷的内部存储空间，甚至&1末影箱&0也可以。高级用户可能会喜欢该物品，因为可通过绑定快捷键直接打开。在GUI中使用相同的快捷键，可清空合成方格内所有物品；按住Shift+快捷键，可自动均衡分配网格内现有物品。通过GUI中的切换按钮，可设定从合成方格中按住Shift移除物品时的两种返还目标：内部存储空间或玩家物品栏。

en_us: Striking it with lightning seems to make it bound to reality so that it can’t be destroyed or disappear when dropped.
zh_cn-old: 被直接雷击会使它充能，这样当成为掉落物时它不会被破坏或者删除。
zh_cn: 用闪电击中它似乎能将其与现实绑定，致使其无法被摧毁，即便被丢弃也不会消失。

en_us: This small block can showcase your favorite items and blocks. It seems to support any wood type, and it can be placed with any rotation you want. You can pipe items in and out from the bottom or the top.
zh_cn-old: 这个小方块能展示你最喜欢的物品和方块。它看起来支持任何种类的木头，且能被你以任何角度放置。
zh_cn: 这个小方块能展示你最爱的物品和方块。似乎能用所有种类的木头合成，且能以任何角度放置。可通过其顶部或底部输入输出物品。

en_us: Interaction from all other sides of the block will be delegated to the item itself, so you can interact with its inventory, fluids, energy, ...
zh_cn-old: 任何其他面的交互都会对展示的物体生效，所以你可以用物品，流体，能量来与其交互……
zh_cn: 任何通过其他面进行的交互都会对展示的物品生效，因此你可以与其物品栏、流体、能量互动……

en_us: Other people find it strange, but I always watch closely when beasts die. I noticed that they mostly give off some strange dark-purple aura which quickly fades again.
zh_cn-old: 你可能觉得这很奇怪，但是我一直在野兽死时认真观察。我注意到它们几乎都会放出很快消失的奇怪暗紫色的光环。
zh_cn: 其他人觉得这很奇怪，但我经常近距离观察生物的死亡。我注意到它们几乎都会释放出一种很快便会消失的奇怪深紫色灵气。

en_us: I noticed that I can use some of the &1Crushed Dark Gem&0 to construct a ring which allows me to fully see those auras of the mobs I kill, though it looks like they can see me as well. They always try to follow me and when they touch me they do some minor damage after which they dissolve into thin air.
zh_cn-old: 我发现我可以使用&1暗能宝石粉&0制作一个指环，这让我能清楚的看到怪物的死亡，但是它们好像也能看见我。它们会试图跟着我，和我接触，当然这会有一点轻微的伤害，之后它们便烟消云散了。
zh_cn: 我注意到可以使用一些&1暗黑宝石粉&0来制作一枚指环，使我能够完全观测到所击杀生物的灵气，不过似乎也会让它们察觉到我。它们总是试图跟着我，当接触到我时，会造成些许伤害，随后便消散于无形之中。

en_us: Activating the ring gives me some amazing powers but this seems to attract and anger some spirits, although most of these spirits are unrecognisable for some reason...
zh_cn-old: 激活这个指环给予我惊人的力量，但是似乎会吸引一些激怒的灵魂，虽然大多数的这些灵魂都已经因为某些原因无法辨认了……
zh_cn: 激活这枚指环会给予我一些有趣的能力，但似乎也会吸引并激怒某些灵魂，尽管它们不知为何大多无法辨识其形貌……

en_us: On some of my adventures I discovered some strange purple boxes which contained some distorted spirits. It looks like these spirits were captured a long time ago and have since been degrading, I don’t think they can be restored to their original state though.
zh_cn-old: 在我的冒险旅途中我发现了一些装有扭曲灵魂的奇怪的紫色箱子。看起来这些灵魂被捕获很久了，到现在已经面目全非，我觉得他们不可能恢复到原来的样子了。
zh_cn: 在冒险途中，我发现了一些封存着扭曲灵魂的奇特紫色箱子。这些灵魂似乎遭禁锢已久，状态从那时起便一直在恶化，我不认为它们还能恢复原状。

zh_cn-old: 负面的药水效果让我痛苦。这个吊坠可以通过消耗&4血液&0移除负面效果。越糟糕的效果消耗越多的血液。它甚至可以熄灭身上的火，不过我不建议你去熔岩里游泳。你需要一种特殊的线来制作它，它可以通过将线和一小块金子组合在一起来制作。
zh_cn: 消除负面药水效果总是令人头疼。这个吊坠能以消耗&4血液&0为代价，祛除所有负面状态。效果越恶劣，消耗的&4血液&0越多。它甚至能扑灭火焰，不过还是不建议去熔岩里游泳。制作此物需使用一种特殊的线，由常规线与少量金粒合成而成。

en_us: After making the &1Invigorating Pendant&0, I started thinking. What if it would be possible to not only remove, but also apply effects? This new pendant is able to hold one &1Potion&0, and by using &4Blood&0 it will continuously apply its effect to you. I noticed that some effects cost more &4Blood&0 than the others. You can insert new &1Potions&0 by simply right-clicking with the item.
zh_cn-old: 制作了&1振奋吊坠&0后我就开始思考，除了移除药水效果，可不可以产生药水效果？这种新的吊坠能产生药水效果，消耗&4血液&0不断产生装入的药水效果，我注意到某些效果格外消耗&4血液&0。你可以通过拿着吊坠右击来放入药水。
zh_cn: 在制作&1振奋吊坠&0后，我开始思考：如果不仅能移除效果，还能主动施加效果会怎样？这款新型吊坠可以储存一瓶&1药水&0，并通过消耗&4血液&0持续将效果施加于佩戴者。我还注意到，不同效果消耗的&4血液&0量存在差异，其中某些效果消耗量明显更高。只需手持吊坠右击即可放入新&1药水&0。

en_us: Effortless Ring
zh_cn-old: 迅捷指环
zh_cn: 助步指环

en_us: I was able to construct a special ring that can apply the &1Promises&0 of &Productivity&0 and &1Velocity&0 which allows you to walk faster, jump higher and step more easily on blocks. Just hold this item anywhere inside your inventory to gain its effects. Note that this step assist can be avoided by holding &oShift&r.
zh_cn-old: 我可以用&1速度的诺言&0和&1效率的诺言&0制作一个指环，可以使我走得更快，踏得更高。把它放在背包就能获得效果。按住&oShift&r可以恢复正常速度。
zh_cn: 使用&1速度的诺言&0和&1效率的诺言&0，我成功打造出了一枚特殊指环，佩戴它可使你行走得更快、跳跃得更高，并自动跨上方块。只需将指环放在物品栏任意位置即可生效。按住&oShift&r可禁用步行辅助功能。

en_us: Kineticator
zh_cn-old: 磁场魔杖
zh_cn: 牵引魔杖

en_us: This item is able to attract items and experience orbs in a certain area. This area can be changed by right-clicking it, enabling or disabling it is done with a simple shift + right-click. Items that are attracted from nearby consumes little to no &4Blood&0, but items from further away will require some more &4Blood&0. Sneaking will avoid kineticating items.
zh_cn-old: 这是一个可以在一定范围了吸引掉落物和经验的物品。范围大小可以用右击调节，使用Shift+右击可以控制开启或者关闭。吸引较近的物品会消耗少量的&4血液&0，而吸引远处的物品会消耗更多的血液。潜行时不吸引物品。
zh_cn: 该物品可吸引特定范围内的物品与经验球。右击可调整作用范围，Shift右击则用于启用/禁用功能。吸引邻近物品几乎不消耗&4血液&0，但远距离牵引需消耗更多&4血液&0。潜行时暂停吸引物品。

en_us: Reversing the recipe will give the opposite version of this item which is able to repel items and experience orbs.
zh_cn-old: 相反的配方带来相反的功能，反磁场魔杖可以排斥物品和经验。
zh_cn: 将合成配方上下翻转，可获得功能相反的版本，该变体能够排斥物品与经验球。

en_us: I feel oddly at peace when there are thunderstorms. That is why I made a simple tool that can spawn such storms. This item can however be used only once, making this a rather expensive process.
zh_cn-old: 在雷暴时，我感到奇怪的平静。所以我制作了一个简单的工具生成雷暴。这个工具只能使用一次，所以是一个相当昂贵的过程。
zh_cn: 雷暴天气总能让我莫名感到安宁，因此我制作了能召唤雷暴的简易工具。然而该物品只能使用一次，导致整个过程成本颇高。

en_us: I’ve discovered a way to reuse the technology from the &1Vengeance Ring&0 into a pickaxe. This seems to drastically reduce the durability of the pickaxe though. But it has an interesting side-effect that when crafted will have the ability to trigger an enormous &1Fortune&0.
zh_cn-old: 我发现了一种方法，把复仇指环的技术运用于镐子。尽管这大大降低了镐子的耐久。但是它有一个强大的副作用，在使用是有触发大量&1时运&0效果的可能。
zh_cn: 我发现了一种将&1复仇指环&0的技术复用于镐子的方法。尽管这会大幅降低镐子的耐久度，却带来了有趣的副作用，这把镐子能够触发极强的&1时运&0效果。

en_us: Gemstone Torch
zh_cn-old: 暗黑火把
zh_cn: 宝石火把

en_us: I was able to combine the &1Burning Gemstone&0 with a &1Dark Stick&0 to make a special torch that seems to absorb any spawning &1Vengeance Spirits&0 in its light area. Note that any spirits spawned outside the area will still be able to wander in this area though, but a simple mundane wall should be able to solve that.
zh_cn-old: 我用一个&1灼烧的暗黑宝石块&0和一个&1暗黑木棍&0制作了一个特殊的火把，它会吸收它照亮的区域产生的&1复仇之魂&0。请注意，在区域外产生的复仇之魂可以走进被照亮的区域，当然普通的墙壁就能住当它们。
zh_cn: 将&1灼烧暗黑宝石块&0与&1暗黑木棍&0结合后，我成功制作出了一种特殊的火把，它会吸收其光照范围内所有新生成的&1复仇之魂&0。注意：在作用范围外生成的灵魂仍可能游荡至范围内，不过普通的墙壁就能挡住它们。

en_us: &1Flesh&0 can be combined with &1Garmonbozia&0 to make it an infinite source of food. You will however need to supply it with &4Blood&0 to be able to eat from it.
zh_cn-old: 通过将&1肉&0与&1痛苦之源&0结合，可以得到无限的食物，只需要给它提供&4血液&0。
zh_cn: 将&1肉&0与&1痛苦之源&0结合可制成无限食物源。但需持续注入&4血液&0才能维持其食用功能。

en_us: Short on &4Blood&0 and always out in the fields attacking mobs? Why not use this sword that will boost the &4Blood&0 you will get in your &1Blood Extractor&0 after killing mobs? As a bonus, this sword will provide a default &1Looting&0 bonus when crafted.
zh_cn-old: 血液短缺而奔走在田野攻击小怪？为什么不适用这把剑，它能使血液提取器获得更多的血液当杀死生物。作为福利，这把剑自带抢夺II。
zh_cn: &4血液&0短缺且经常在野外猎杀生物？何不选用此剑来击杀生物，以提高&1血液提取器&0获取的&4血液&0量？额外福利：该剑将自带&1抢夺 II&0魔咒效果。

en_us: Mace of Distortion
zh_cn-old: 立场扭曲锤
zh_cn: 扭曲重锤

en_us: Holding right-click with this mace will build up a circular sphere around it that, when released, will trigger a force upon all other entities within that sphere knocking them back and causing some damage as long as the mace has enough &4Blood&0. Shift + right-clicking it will cycle through the different power levels, each higher level will cause more damage, but at the same time cost more &4Blood&0.
zh_cn-old: 按住鼠标右键就会在附近产生一个圆形的扭曲力场，当释放鼠标时，就能触发立场，作用于周围的生物，将其击退并产生伤害，当然这需要足够的&4血液&0。Shift+右击就能调节产生立场的范围功率，更高的功率会造成更多的伤害并消耗更多的&4血液&0。
zh_cn: 手持该物品长按右键，可凝聚环绕周身的球形力场，松开右键时，将向力场范围内所有实体释放冲击，造成击退效果与一定伤害（前提是扭曲重锤有足够的&4血液&0）。Shift右击可循环切换不同强度等级，等级越高伤害越高，但消耗的&4血液&0也越多。

en_us: &1Zombies&0 seem to be controllable once you have a skull of some kind. After mounting such a skull on a staff I discovered that I can spawn zombies that will attack any entity I target for a limited amount of time.
zh_cn-old: 僵尸视乎可以通过某些头颅来控制，偶然安装了头颅后发现我可以生成僵尸攻击我标记的目标，当然他们的存在时间有限。
zh_cn: &1僵尸&0似乎可通过某种骷髅头进行操控。将这种骷髅头安装于法杖顶端后，我发现其获得了能召唤僵尸的能力，召唤出的僵尸存在时间有限，会攻击我所指定的任意目标实体。

en_us: Mace of Destruction
zh_cn-old: 毁灭之锤
zh_cn: 毁灭重锤

en_us: This is a variant of the &1Mace of Distortion&0, the force that is released by this mace is actually a powerful explosion. The longer you charge the mace, the bigger the explosion will be. Increasing the power level of this mace will increase the starting power of the explosion, so you can charge even more.
zh_cn-old: 它是&力场扭曲锤&0的升级版，它可以释放强力的爆炸。按住的时间越长，爆炸威力越大。可以通过调大功率来调大威力，你也可以充能更久。
zh_cn: 升级版的&扭曲重锤&0，其释放的冲击变为强力的爆炸。蓄力时间越长，爆炸规模越大。提升强度等级可增强爆炸的初始威力，从而进一步延长蓄力时间。

en_us: Having &1Vengeance Spirits&0 contained in boxes is not very useful by itself. I theorized that it might be possible to revive the spirits using some &4Blood&0...
zh_cn-old: 把&1复仇之魂&0 封印在灵魂箱中本身并没有什么用。我推测，会有一种使用&4血液&0和这些灵魂的方法……
zh_cn: 将&1复仇之魂&0收容于匣子中本身并无实际用途。根据理论推测，或许能借助&4血液&0令其复苏……

en_us: I finally succeeded in reviving &1Vengeance Spirits&0, or at least partially. The revived spirits seem to be too weak to live in the real world, but they seem to have all the properties and materials of real mobs though. There is however a use for this discovery, when building a large machine that can contain the resulting mob it will, at the cost of a large amount of &4Blood&0, revive the spirit and immediately cook it alive. This will result in the drops of these mobs to be collected in the machine’s inventory. It looks like the &1Box of Eternal Closure&0 can indefinitely be reused without the spirit ever getting out of it.
zh_cn-old: 我最终成功重铸了&1复仇之魂&0，或者说一部分。这种重铸的灵魂非常虚弱，以至于不能存活在现实世界，但是他们仍然会掉落那些相应生物的掉落物。然而为了使用这个发现，制造一个大型机器用来重铸灵魂。消耗大量的血液，会使这些灵魂立即复活。如果灵魂没有逃走的话，似乎&1永恒灵魂箱&0可以无限的使用。
zh_cn: 我最终成功复活了&1复仇之魂&0，至少是成功了一部分。复活的灵魂过于虚弱，无法在现实世界存活，但它们似乎保留了原生物的所有特性和材料。虽然如此，这一发现仍有实用价值，只要建造一台能容纳灵魂的大型机器，消耗大量&4血液&0，便可复活灵魂，并随即将其活烹。最终将生物掉落物收集至机器中。值得注意的是，&1永锢之匣&0似乎可无限重复使用，灵魂永远无法逃脱。

en_us: You will need a bunch of tough blocks, like &1Dark Bricks&0 infused with some &4Blood&0 to make sure the spirits can’t get out. You will need to build a cubic structure of these blocks so that the mob you wish to reanimate has room enough to fit in the inside of the structure. A zombie for example is one block wide and two blocks high, so you will need a structure of three blocks wide and four blocks high with a hollow space inside. If the mob you try to contain is very large you might even need to build a structure that is as large as a nine-by-nine, not too shabby!
zh_cn-old: 你需要一堆坚韧的方块，似乎注入一些&4血液&0的&1黑砖&0可以确保这种需要，灵魂也无法从中逃脱。你需要建造一个立方体结构，而内部结构足够大以适应你捕捉的灵魂的大小。拿僵尸做个例子，你需要两格高，所以你要建造一个3*4*3的立方体结构，使它中空两个方块的大小。如果你想容纳的生物很大，你可能需要一个9*9的结构，不要太小气哦！
zh_cn: 建造该装置需使用坚固方块（如注入&4血液&0的&1暗黑砖&0）以确保灵魂无法逃脱。用这些方块搭建立方体结构，内部需留足空间容纳目标生物。例如，僵尸本身占地为1x1格宽、2格高，因此需建造3x4x3的空心结构。若要收容大型生物，甚至需要搭建9x9规模的巨型结构，还不错不是吗！

en_us: You will also need a single &1Spirit Furnace&0 block somewhere in the structure. This block can easily be connected to other inventories or tanks using the known means. You will see a distinct red glow when the structure has been successfully assembled.
zh_cn-old: 你也需要预留一块地方放置&1灵魂炉&0。这个方块可以用已知的手段链接到其他容器或者液体罐。你看见&4红光&0时表示结构搭建完成。
zh_cn: 结构中还需放置一个&1灵魂炉&0方块，可通过常规方式连接其他容器或储罐。成功成型后，该结构会显现醒目的红光。

en_us: After the discovery of the &1Spirit Furnace&0 I was still determined to revive those spirits. To solve the problem of unstable mobs I put them inside &1Eggs&0, as an attempt to stabilize them. This process still requires some substantial amount of &4Blood&0 and of course an empty &1Egg&0.
zh_cn-old: 发明了&1灵魂炉&0之后，我还是想要复活这些灵魂。为了解决它们不稳定这些问题，我尝试把它们放到&1鸡蛋&0里面。这个过程也需要一些&4血液&0，当然也需要一个&1鸡蛋&0。
zh_cn: 尽管发明了&1灵魂炉&0，我仍致力于完全复活灵魂。为解决灵魂不稳定的问题，我尝试将其收容进&1鸡蛋&0中以维持形态。该过程仍需消耗大量&4血液&0，当然还需要一个&1鸡蛋&0作为容器。

en_us: Because of this more advanced process, spirits will be completely used up, so only one &1Egg&0 can be created per &1spirit&0.
zh_cn-old: 由于这种先进的工艺，灵魂会被消耗掉，所以每个&1灵魂&0只能制作一个&1刷怪蛋&0。
zh_cn: 由于采用更先进的工艺，灵魂会被完全消耗，因此每个&1灵魂&0仅能生成一枚&1刷怪蛋&0。

en_us: Some mobs however seem to refuse to enter the &1Egg&0, so their spirits will be lost forever.
zh_cn-old: 然而有些灵魂拒绝成为&1刷怪蛋&0，所以他们的灵魂会直接消失……
zh_cn: 然而有些生物似乎拒绝进入&1鸡蛋&0，所以它们的灵魂将永远消失。

en_us: Spirit-Killing 101
zh_cn-old: 灵魂杀手 101
zh_cn: 灵魂杀手入门

en_us: After handling spirits one after the other, I became quite comfortable with being among them. Because of that, I was able to notice some of their specific traits, and even fears! They seem to dislike anything having to do with 'endings' in any form.
zh_cn-old: 处理掉一个又一个的灵魂后，我变得相当舒适。因此，我能够注意到它们的某些特质，甚至恐惧！它们似乎不喜欢任何与“末影”有关的东西。
zh_cn: 在接连处理了一个又一个灵魂后，我逐渐适应了与它们相处。正因如此，我注意到了它们的某些特质，甚至是它们的恐惧！灵魂似乎厌恶任何与“终末”有关的事物。

en_us: I was always annoyed by the fact that those nasty spirits could attack me, and there was nothing I could do against them. That is why I investigated a way to damage them. It looks like their fear of endings was grounded, because those things damage them. Using some 'end'-relics, I was able to transform my &1Vengeance Focus&0 to an improved version which is able to damage them.
zh_cn-old: 这些肮脏的灵魂对我的攻击一直令我很厌烦，但我却无可奈何。所幸我找到了一种伤害它们的方法。看起来它们从本质上厌恶着末影，因为那些东西会伤害它们。使用一些“末影”遗物，我能够将我的&1复仇之焦&0升级为一个可以伤害它们的版本。
zh_cn: 那些可恶的灵魂可以肆意攻击我，而我却无法反击，这总让我倍感恼火。因此，我找寻出了一种能够伤害它们的方法。灵魂对“终末”的恐惧似乎确有缘由，因为相关事物确实能对其造成伤害。通过利用一些“末地”遗物，我将&1复仇聚焦核心&0改造成了能对其造成伤害的强化版本。

en_us: This new focus appeared to be strong enough to completely 'kill' any spirit. But to my suprise, they drop some stuff. This includes some things that their old physical form carried and also some ghastly dust, which seems to carry the spirits' darkest parts and may prove useful in the future...
zh_cn-old: 这个新复仇之焦似乎足够强到完全“杀死”任何灵魂。但是当我惊喜之时，它们掉落了一些东西。这包括它们过去的身体携带的东西以及一些可怕的粉尘，其似乎承载着灵魂最黑暗的部分，这可能在未来被证明是有用的……
zh_cn: 新的聚焦核心似乎强大到足以彻底“杀死”任何灵魂。出乎意料的是，它们竟然会掉落物品。包括它们生前肉体携带的东西，以及一些幽灵般的粉尘，其似乎承载着灵魂最黑暗的部分，或许在未来能派上用场……

en_us: What if it was possible to imbue the darkest thoughts and emotions into this world. This could prove to be an immense source of unimaginable power. With the discovery of vengeance, darkness and blood, I think I may have the essential elements.
zh_cn-old: 假如最黑暗的想法和情绪渗透进这个世界该怎么办？这可能是无法想象的力量的巨大来源。随着复仇，暗黑和血的发现，我想我可能拥有了基本的要素。
zh_cn: 若能将最黑暗的思想与情感注入现实世界，或许就能创造出难以想象的巨大能量源泉。通过研究复仇、暗黑与血液，我认为自己已掌握了核心要素。

en_us: Combining these elements resulted in a strange spiritual energy. It is so otherwordly, that it does not have its own material, which is why it is observed as some kind of creamed corn.
zh_cn-old: 结合这些要素产生了一种奇怪的精神能量。它是这样的超脱凡尘，其本身不具有物质，它看起来跟玉米粒糊一样。
zh_cn: 融合这些要素后，一种奇异的灵魂能量诞生了。其存在形式完全超脱物质形态，因此在观测中呈现为类似奶油玉米的奇特样貌。

en_us: My subjects say I have gone too far with this, the fools.
zh_cn-old: 我跑题跑太远了……
zh_cn: 那些庸碌之辈竟敢妄言我在此道走得太远，何其愚昧。
